approvals.reason: Pre-lock change from #1399: an account's profile limit now inherits its access group's limit unless the account overrides it, like the other policy fields, so a null max_profiles means the account inherits and effective_policy.max_profiles carries the limit that applies. The bundled web admin pages read both in the same change. The Apple and Android apps don't read max_profiles. The frozen v1 admin user body keeps reporting the limit that applies.
